chapter: The Washingtonians, Bechet and drum style
title: The three-man group in Washington and who came to New York
summary: Crouch asks about a photo of Duke, Sterling Conway and Greer at Thomas' cafe and when Snowden joined.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: There were a couple of things I wanted to get clear about how the band developed in Washington

and when you first -- and when you and Ellington and Hardwicke first began to get together, now, like for instance, in this the early twenties, picture we have here which is from / and at Louis Thomas. band You have it, three-member/ here with Sterling -- I mean was everybody here in the band?
Yeah, this was the band -- these were the singers. This was Duke, this is Sterling Conway and me. That's all.
This is page 31 of Music Is My Mistress. Now, when did Elmer Snowden and the other people come into the group?
In New York, they came in.
How many people from the band in Washington ended up in the band in New York?
